e8_lattice.name: E8 Lattice
e8_lattice.current_text: The densest way to pack spheres in eight dimensions.
e8_lattice.research: The Transfinite Hierarchy - Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

cantor_key.name: Cantor Key
cantor_key.current_text: Opens the Transfinite Hierarchy, where every infinity has its own place. Use again to return.

false_vacuum_membrane.name: False Vacuum Membrane
false_vacuum_membrane.current_text: The skin of a Vacuum Drifter: the wall between two vacua.

hotel_key.name: Hilbert's Hotel Key
hotel_key.current_text: Opens room n+1. There is always a room n+1.

brane_tether.name: Brane Tether
brane_tether.current_text: Ties your mass to our brane. Carry it in the Bulk - or in any field of extra dimensions.

primordial_charter.name: Primordial Charter
primordial_charter.current_text: A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality.

form_of_the_self.name: Form of the Self
form_of_the_self.current_text: Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.

coherence_stabiliser.name: Coherence Stabiliser
coherence_stabiliser.current_text: Keeps your wavefunction in one piece. Carry it in the Quantum Foam - or in an altered vacuum.

well_ordering_charm.name: Well-Ordering Charm
well_ordering_charm.current_text: Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy.

identity_kernel.name: Identity Kernel
identity_kernel.current_text: The smallest thing that is still you. Carry it in the Transcendental.

graviton_harness.name: Graviton Harness
graviton_harness.current_text: Spreads crushing gravity evenly through you. Carry it into high-gravity fields.

chronal_anchor.name: Chronal Anchor
chronal_anchor.current_text: Holds your own clock steady. Carry it into fields where time runs fast or slow.

proof_of_everything.name: Proof of Everything
proof_of_everything.current_text: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.

entanglement_tuner.name: Entanglement Tuner
entanglement_tuner.current_text: Links Entangled Transceivers to one channel. Sneak-use a transceiver to switch it between sending and receiving.

empirical_dossier.name: Empirical Dossier
empirical_dossier.current_text: Every early discovery, written up. A Research Nexus can study it in your place.
empirical_dossier.research: Research Synthesis - Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

theoretical_dossier.name: Theoretical Dossier
theoretical_dossier.current_text: The theories of the middle ages of your research. Feeds a Research Nexus.
theoretical_dossier.research: Superintelligence - A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

unified_dossier.name: Unified Dossier
unified_dossier.current_text: Everything up to the edge of mathematics, unified. Feeds a Research Nexus.
unified_dossier.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

absolute_dossier.name: Absolute Dossier
absolute_dossier.current_text: The research of a civilisation that has nearly finished. Feeds a Research Nexus.
absolute_dossier.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

empirical_notes_1.name: Empirical Notes I
empirical_notes_1.current_text: One third of a Research Dossier.
empirical_notes_1.research: Research Synthesis - Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

unified_notes_3.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

absolute_notes_1.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

absolute_notes_2.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

absolute_notes_3.current_text: One third of a Research Dossier.
absolute_notes_3.research: The Omnilex - Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

zeolite_catalyst.name: Zeolite Catalyst
zeolite_catalyst.current_text: A crystal full of molecule-sized pores; reactions that fit inside go faster.
zeolite_catalyst.research: Chemical Bonding - Atoms share electrons because a shared wavefunction has lower energy. Unlocks the Chemical Reactor.

molecular_orbital_lattice.name: Molecular Orbital Lattice
molecular_orbital_lattice.current_text: Electron wavefunctions shared between atoms, frozen into a grid. This is what a chemical bond is.
molecular_orbital_lattice.research: Quantum Chemistry - Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

chiral_crystal.name: Chiral Crystal
chiral_crystal.current_text: Left-handed or right-handed, never both. Life only uses one hand.
chiral_crystal.research: Quantum Chemistry - Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

electride_crystal.name: Electride Crystal
electride_crystal.current_text: A salt whose negative ions are bare electrons sitting in holes in the lattice.
electride_crystal.research: Electrochemistry - Chemistry is electrons moving; push them with a voltage. Unlocks the Electrolytic Cell.

graphene_sheet.name: Graphene Sheet
graphene_sheet.current_text: Carbon one atom thick. Stronger than steel, conducts better than copper.
graphene_sheet.research: Nanochemistry - Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

carbon_nanotube_bundle.name: Carbon Nanotube Bundle
carbon_nanotube_bundle.current_text: Graphene rolled into tubes, the tubes twisted into rope.
carbon_nanotube_bundle.research: Nanochemistry - Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

buckyball_cage.name: Buckyball Cage
buckyball_cage.current_text: Sixty carbon atoms arranged like a football - with room inside for one more atom.
buckyball_cage.research: Nanochemistry - Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

metal_organic_framework.name: Metal-Organic Framework
metal_organic_framework.current_text: Metal nodes, organic struts: a sponge with more inner surface than a football pitch per gram.
metal_organic_framework.research: Supramolecular Chemistry - Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

noble_gas_clathrate.name: Noble Gas Clathrate
noble_gas_clathrate.current_text: Xenon caged in ice. The noble gases are not as aloof as the textbooks said.
noble_gas_clathrate.research: Supramolecular Chemistry - Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

self_healing_polymer.name: Self-Healing Polymer
self_healing_polymer.current_text: Cut it and the chains find each other again.
self_healing_polymer.research: Supramolecular Chemistry - Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

room_temperature_superconductor.name: Room-Temperature Superconductor
room_temperature_superconductor.current_text: Zero resistance without cryogenics. Physicists have chased this for a century.
room_temperature_superconductor.research: Room-Temperature Superconductivity - Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.

positronium_hydride.name: Positronium Hydride
positronium_hydride.current_text: A molecule made of a hydrogen atom and an atom of matter bound to antimatter. It lasts a nanosecond - unless you trap it.
positronium_hydride.research: Exotic Chemistry - Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

muonic_catalyst.name: Muonic Catalyst
muonic_catalyst.current_text: Swap an electron for a muon and atoms shrink 200 times - close enough to fuse cold.
muonic_catalyst.research: Exotic Chemistry - Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

flerovium_ingot.name: Flerovium Ingot
flerovium_ingot.current_text: Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons.
flerovium_ingot.research: The Island of Stability - Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.

unbihexium_ingot.name: Unbihexium Ingot
unbihexium_ingot.current_text: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long.
unbihexium_ingot.research: The Island of Stability - Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.

gene_sampler.name: Gene Sampler
gene_sampler.current_text: Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples.

genome_sample.name: Genome Sample
genome_sample.current_text: Every instruction for building one creature, in a vial.

xenogenome_sample.name: Xenogenome Sample
xenogenome_sample.current_text: A genome from a creature of another dimension. Its code is not written in DNA.

recombinant_dna.name: Recombinant DNA
recombinant_dna.current_text: A double helix spliced from more than one creature.
recombinant_dna.research: Genomics - Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.

engineered_enzyme.name: Engineered Enzyme
engineered_enzyme.current_text: A protein designed to speed up exactly one reaction a millionfold.
engineered_enzyme.research: Genomics - Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.

folded_protein_crystal.name: Folded Protein Crystal
folded_protein_crystal.current_text: A chain of amino acids that found its one shape out of more than the universe has atoms.
folded_protein_crystal.research: Protein Folding - A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.

stem_cell_culture.name: Stem Cell Culture
stem_cell_culture.current_text: Cells that have not yet decided what to become.
stem_cell_culture.research: Synthetic Biology - Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

synthetic_cell.name: Minimal Synthetic Cell
synthetic_cell.current_text: The smallest genome that can still be alive, written from scratch.
synthetic_cell.research: Synthetic Biology - Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

xenobot_swarm.name: Xenobot Swarm
xenobot_swarm.current_text: Living machines made of cells, designed by an evolutionary algorithm.
xenobot_swarm.research: Synthetic Biology - Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

tardigrade_culture.name: Tardigrade Culture
tardigrade_culture.current_text: Survives vacuum, radiation and freezing by simply pausing being alive.
tardigrade_culture.research: Extremophiles - Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.

quantum_chlorophyll.name: Quantum Chlorophyll
quantum_chlorophyll.current_text: Photosynthesis moves energy by trying every path at once - coherently.
quantum_chlorophyll.research: Quantum Biology - Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.

cryptochrome_magnetoreceptor.name: Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor
cryptochrome_magnetoreceptor.current_text: The protein in a robin's eye that feels Earth's field through entangled radical pairs.
cryptochrome_magnetoreceptor.research: Quantum Biology - Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.

neural_organoid.name: Neural Organoid
neural_organoid.current_text: A pea-sized brain grown in a dish. It has started to dream.
neural_organoid.research: Neurobiology - Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.

turing_morphogen.name: Turing Morphogen
turing_morphogen.current_text: Two chemicals, one fast and one slow, that paint stripes and spots by themselves.
turing_morphogen.research: Morphogenesis - How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.

silicon_life_spore.name: Silicon Life Spore
silicon_life_spore.current_text: Life built on silicon instead of carbon. It grew in the Bulk.
silicon_life_spore.research: Xenobiology - Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

telomerase_complex.name: Telomerase Complex
telomerase_complex.current_text: Rebuilds the clocks at the ends of chromosomes. Cells that have it do not age.
telomerase_complex.research: Directed Evolution - A million generations in a minute, if time runs fast enough. Unlocks the Evolution Engine and telomerase.

spark_of_life.name: Spark of Life
spark_of_life.current_text: The moment chemistry became biology, caught and kept.
spark_of_life.research: Abiogenesis - Where chemistry becomes life. Unlocks the Abiogenesis Crucible and the Spark of Life.

panspermia_seed.name: Panspermia Seed
panspermia_seed.current_text: Life packed to survive the trip between universes.
panspermia_seed.research: Panspermia - Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

omnicellular_genome.name: Omnicellular Genome
omnicellular_genome.current_text: One genome that can build any creature in any dimension.
omnicellular_genome.research: Panspermia - Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

containment_cell.name: Empty Containment Cell
containment_cell.current_text: A magnetically sealed flask for fluids too hot, too cold or too strange for a bucket. Scoop a source block or fill it from a tank.

assembly_matrix.name: Assembly Matrix
assembly_matrix.current_text: A femtoscale jig that holds a hundred parts in exactly the right place while the Extreme Assembly Table joins them.
assembly_matrix.research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

hyperlattice_frame.name: Hyperlattice Frame
hyperlattice_frame.current_text: A scaffold folded through a fourth dimension, so a nine-by-nine assembly has room for its insides.
hyperlattice_frame.research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

transfinite_weave.name: Transfinite Weave
transfinite_weave.current_text: Cloth with more threads than there are numbers to count them. Endgame assemblies are stitched on it.
transfinite_weave.research: Transfinite Mathematics - Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

oracle_lemma.name: Oracle's Lemma
oracle_lemma.current_text: Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.

spacetime_alloy_coil_block.name: Spacetime Alloy Coil Block
spacetime_alloy_coil_block.research: Component Tiers - Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.

cosmic_neutronium_coil_block.name: Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block
cosmic_neutronium_coil_block.research: Component Tiers - Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.

transfinite_coil_block.name: Transfinite Coil Block
transfinite_coil_block.research: Stellar Transcendence - Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

graviton_field_emitter.name: Graviton Field Emitter
graviton_field_emitter.research: Component Tiers - Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.

axiomatic_field_emitter.name: Axiomatic Field Emitter
axiomatic_field_emitter.research: Axiom Theory - Beneath the source code of reality lie its axioms - and axioms can be distilled, edited and broken. Unlocks the Axiom Distiller.
